nodes.description: uint256 public preSalePrice = 0.020 ether; unit price used in the presale mint payment check
uint256 public salePrice = 0.045 ether; unit price used in the public sale mint payment check
uint256 public preSaleStartTime; timestamp gating the start of the presale window
uint256 public saleStartTime; timestamp ending presale and starting public sale
uint256 public soldOutStartTime; timestamp ending public sale and starting gift period
uint256 public soldOutEndTime; timestamp ending the gift period
mapping(address => uint256) public per-wallet presale mint counter
string public baseURI concatenated with token id in tokenURI
uint256 private teamLength; bounds the releaseAll payee loop
ERC721r remaining mintable token counter, decremented on every mint
ERC721r mapping(address => uint256) token balance bookkeeping
ERC721r mapping(uint256 => address) token ownership record
PaymentSplitter mapping(address => uint256) amount of ETH already released to a payee
msg.sender; unvalidated caller used for presale counters and ownership checks
block.timestamp; miner-influenced time source used for gating and randomness
tx.origin; used by callerIsUser as an anti-contract check
external payable preSaleMint(address,uint256) guarded by callerIsUser; enforces time windows, wallet limit and payment then mints
external payable saleMint(address,uint256) guarded by callerIsUser; enforces sale window and payment then mints
external onlyOwner gift(address,uint256) minting free tokens after sell-out while supplies last
external onlyOwner setBaseUri(string) writing the metadata base URI
external onlyOwner setter for preSaleStartTime emitting DateChange
external onlyOwner setter for saleStartTime emitting DateChange
external onlyOwner setter for soldOutStartTime emitting DateChange
external onlyOwner setter for soldOutEndTime emitting DateChange
internal view currentTime() returning block.timestamp for all window checks
public view tokenURI(uint256) building metadata URI from baseURI
external unrestricted releaseAll() looping over all payees and calling release
public release(address payable) / release(IERC20,address) computing and pushing payments to a payee
internal _mintRandom(address,uint) minting a batch of randomly chosen token ids and updating balances
internal getRandomAvailableTokenId computing a pseudo-random index from block/tx variables
internal getAvailableTokenAtIndex implementing the Fisher-Yates style swap-and-pop on _availableTokens
modifier callerIsUser requiring tx.origin == msg.sender
receive() external payable override that reverts unless ETH arrives through minting
private _mintIdWithoutBalanceUpdate writing _owners[tokenId] and emitting Transfer
External ETH transfer via Address.sendValue(account, payment) inside release
External ERC20 transfer via SafeERC20.safeTransfer(token, account, payment) inside release
Persistent mint state mutations: _numAvailableTokens decrement and _balances[to] increment
_account address parameter of preSaleMint (mint recipient)
_quantity uint256 parameter of preSaleMint
_account address parameter of saleMint (mint recipient)
_quantity uint256 parameter of saleMint
_to address parameter of gift
_quantity uint256 parameter of gift
_baseURI string parameter of setBaseUri
time uint256 parameter of setPreSaleStartTime
time uint256 parameter of setSaleStartTime
time uint256 parameter of setSoldOutStartTime
time uint256 parameter of setSoldOutEndTime
account address parameter of release (payee being paid)
_tokenId uint256 parameter of tokenURI
indexToUse uint256 parameter of getAvailableTokenAtIndex
_numToMint uint256 parameter of _mintRandom
local price copy of preSalePrice inside preSaleMint
local price copy of salePrice inside saleMint
updatedNumAvailableTokens running counter inside _mintRandom
randomNum keccak256 pseudo-random value
randomIndex modulus of randomNum over available tokens
valAtIndex value read from _availableTokens[indexToUse]
result resolved token id returned by the shuffle helper
lastIndex = updatedNumAvailableTokens - 1 used for swap-and-pop
tokenId loop local returned by getRandomAvailableTokenId
payment amount computed by _pendingPayment inside release
loop index i over payees inside releaseAll
